description: Entirely fictional demonstration data for Cedarbridge Institute's Transport Department. No real institution, service, route, fee, schedule, or policy is represented.

passages.title: Transport office hours and location (fictional)
passages.text: The fictional Cedarbridge Institute Transport Office is in Room T-12 and is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 16:00.

passages.title: Route A morning timetable (fictional)
passages.text: In this fictional dataset, Route A leaves Maple Gate at 07:40, stops at Clock Square at 07:55, and arrives at Cedarbridge Institute at 08:15.

passages.title: Route B morning timetable (fictional)
passages.text: In this fictional dataset, Route B leaves Lake Arcade at 07:30, stops at Birch Circle at 07:50, and arrives at Cedarbridge Institute at 08:10.

passages.title: Evening return buses (fictional)
passages.text: In this fictional dataset, Route A and Route B return buses leave Cedarbridge Institute from Bay 2 at 17:10 on teaching weekdays.

passages.title: Bus pass application documents (fictional)
passages.text: For a bus pass at fictional Cedarbridge Institute, submit Form T-01, a student ID copy, and one photograph at the Transport Office.

passages.title: Semester bus pass fee and validity (fictional)
passages.text: The fictional Cedarbridge Institute semester bus pass costs INR 1,800 and is valid for one teaching semester.

passages.title: Lost bus pass replacement (fictional)
passages.text: To replace a lost bus pass at fictional Cedarbridge Institute, report the loss at the Transport Office, submit Form T-02, and pay INR 100.

passages.title: Route change requests (fictional)
passages.text: At fictional Cedarbridge Institute, submit Form T-03 at the Transport Office at least two working days before a requested route change; changes require an available seat.

passages.title: Planned cancellation notices (fictional)
passages.text: At fictional Cedarbridge Institute, planned bus cancellations are posted on the noticeboard outside Room T-12 by 18:00 on the previous working day.

passages.title: Lost property reporting (fictional)
passages.text: At fictional Cedarbridge Institute, report an item left on a bus to the Transport Office with the route, travel date, and item description.
